question: Which Indian-American player has won the Wimbledon junior men's title in July 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Samir Banerjee.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The** men's singles champion at Wimbledon in 2021** was **Samir Banerjee.**
 
• The 17-year-old Samir Banerjee beat fellow **American Victor Lilov 7-5, 6-3 **on Court 1 at the All England Lawn Tennis and Croquet Club in London.
 
• This was Samir Banerjee's** second appearance **at a junior Grand Slam.
 
• According to the** junior International Tennis Federation (ITF) rankings,** the adolescent is ranked **19.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Siddhant Banthia:**

 
 
• **Tennis player **Siddhant Banthia is from India.
 
• Banthia's highest **ATP singles** ranking till date is **1125,** attained on August 23, 2021.
 
• Additionally, on May 27, 2019, he attained a** career-high ATP doubles ranking of 591.**
 
 
 
• **Adil Kalyanpur:**
 
 
• **​​Indian tennis player** Adil Kalyanpur, 22, has a career-high doubles ranking of 591.
 
 
 
• Dhruv Sunish:
 
 
• He is a **tennis player **from India who has a **career-high singles ranking of No. 942.**
